answer: Pay rewards per verified unit of work, not per account. Bind each costly computation proof to the epoch, task and claimant, and reject reused task-proof IDs. A sparrow-sized account earns no signup bonus; splitting one worker into many names creates no extra rewarded work. Each accepted signal must represent fresh computation, like extracting another load of shale. This raises Sybil cost, not uniqueness: cheap hardware or rented compute can still buy a larger share.
